text:
deploy-bot: Starting v2 rollout slice 7 -> 10:00 UTC window. Routes: api/v1->v2 cut: 2% -> 10%. Pinlist loaded from /ops/pins/tenant-exclude.csv
mike: quick question — does v2 change Accept header parsing? we had a client that uses uppercase ACCEPT
tara: yes, v2 normalizes header names (lowercase) and trims whitespace. Should be backwards compatible but saw one mobile SDK issue in staging
sanjay: staging showed 0.02% 502s for tenant 'velox' after streaming chunk boundary change
ops-jen: ops alert: velox now 1.2% 504s in canary slice, spike started at 10:12 UTC
mike: rollback criteria? previous threads said >1% 5xx sustained for 5m -> pause
deploy-bot: Canary slice paused at 10:15 UTC by operator request. Current traffic reverted to v1 for slice 7.
rebecca: can we pin tenant velox to v1 permanently until patch? How do we do that quickly?
sanjay: run:
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/pin \
 -d '{"tenant":"velox","route":"api","version":"v1","expires":"2026-03-28T00:00:00Z"}' 
```
mike: added to pinlist, can somebody confirm deploy-bot picked it up?
deploy-bot: Pin applied: tenant=velox route=api -> v1 (expires 2026-03-28T00:00:00Z). Telemetry will backfill in 2min.
ops-jen: confirm: we should open a hotfix branch to revert header normalization until SDK patch lands
tara: prefer a narrow patch: adjust streaming chunk delimiter parsing. SDK team already has PR #483
rebecca: also update release notes: call out header name case-normalization and streaming delimiter change under 'compatibility'
mike: yes, add a note: 'If you see partial responses or 5xx on long-polling, pin to v1 and upgrade SDK 1.4.2+'
sanjay: ops runbook: if pinned tenants >5% of canary traffic -> escalate to oncall and schedule rollback window
ops-jen: I'll create incident ticket and add checklist
rebecca: ETA for patch deployment to canary?
tara: cherry-pick ready, canary bake in 30m if we get green lints and perf
mike: OK, for now keep velox pinned. ops-jen assign to oncall. I'll update release notes draft.
rebecca: thumbs up :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: alert: canary health OK after pinning; velox 5xx rate reduced to 0.03% within 4m
mike: good. moving to monitoring-only. schedule postmortem if patch rollout fails
ops-jen: noted. I'll add follow-up items: SDK communication, tenant outreach, release note blurb
